content.title: Stock Of The Day Nears Buy Point As It Leads Industry In This Regard
content.summary: Dallas-based ATI serves the aviation, defense, health care, electronics and energy markets, but its military and jet-engine businesses generate most of its revenue and growth.  In the third quarter, defense sales jumped 51% year over year.  Sales of jet-engine components rose 19% and have grown into ATI's largest business, now accounting for 39% of total revenue.
